description: Source code for the Goteo project's CrowdinCommand class, a console command for importing translation data from Crowdin and updating the README.md file with translator info.

classes.name: CrowdinCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing Crowdin project data and updating README with translator info.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, options, arguments, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that triggers reading from Crowdin API and optionally updates README.md.

methods.name: readme
methods.description: Fetches translator data from Crowdin API and updates the README.md file with the list of contributors.
